agent_note: Two-timeline structure, not diary/epistolary: a simultaneous present-tense present-day line (q05440, q05444, q05446, q05455, q05458, q05462) interleaved with a retrospective past-tense strand about the marriage, the grandfather, and the husband's woodturning (q05412, q05425, q05432, q05433, q05435, q05443, q05453, q05454). The dialogue quotes corroborate the split independently: present-day scenes carry present tags ('I say', 'he says' - q05442, q05457, q05459) while flashback scenes carry past tags ('I said' - q05450, q05456). Event split is 10 present / 8 past (55.6% present), so both tenses clear 25% and the minority traces to an identifiable strand - a Mixed/strand finding under METHODOLOGY, not a threshold pass in either direction. Well outside the flagged 70-85% present band. Very heavy aphorism load (25 gnomic of 52, 48%) - a two-bucket filter would have read almost all of it as present-tense evidence. Two flagged calls, q05436 and q05460, are future-tense projection from a present now; if both were dropped the split would be 8/8 and the mixed-strand finding would stand unchanged, so no single quote flips this book.
